del_edge_set.note: Edge-family deletion: same vertex type, and x -- y exactly when x -- y in G and [set x; y] is not in F. Members of F that are not edges have no effect; the edge set is E(G) :\: F; F = set0 deletes nothing, F = E(G) deletes every edge, F = [set e] deletes the single pair e.

del_es_rel.note: The adjacency of del_edge_set G F: (x -- y) && ([set x; y] \notin F), symmetric and irreflexive.
